description:
﻿Non-Material Amendment to planning permission reference 202512 granted 20/04/2021 to allow for minor amendment to block A approved via Planning Permission 202512 to facilitate fire safety
improvements with internal works including creation of dedicated escape routes; creation of
sterile egress points from cores; provision of ventilation to lobbies; redistribution of refuse and
cycle spaces; removal of flat entrances direct from cores; provision of smoke shafts and
ventilation with Automatic Opening Vent (AOV) windows added to lobbies; limited small scale
adjustment to layout of affected apartments, along with elevation changes including provision of
11no. additional AOV windows; conversion of 2no. approved doors to be AOV; conversion of
11no. approved windows to be AOV; insertion of 2no. additional swing doors and changed mortar
detailing relative to lower floors (north and east elevations).
